div.head: Cn 1018 10.1
div.ab: And se ðe eard wille rihtlice clænsian 7 unriht alecgan. 7 rihtwisnesse lufian. þonne mot he georne þillices styran. 7 þillic ascunian.
And se ðe eard wille rihtlice clænsian and unriht alecgan and rihtwisnesse lufian, þonne mot he georne þillices styran and þillic ascunian.
And he who wishes rightly to cleanse the land and suppress wrongdoing, and love righteousness, must zealously prohibit and avoid such offences.
And anyone who desires to properly purify the realm and eradicate injustice and embrace righteousness must diligently stamp out and condemn such crimes.
